note: This file is a configuration dictionary (no callable functions, classes, or methods). It defines model settings for an EfficientNetV2-B1 ImageClassifier backbone with GlobalAveragePooling neck and LinearClsHead (1000 classes, 1280 input channels, CrossEntropyLoss, top-1/5 evaluation).
load_config: load the EfficientNetV2-B1 model configuration dictionary for image classification training
modify_backbone: modify the EfficientNetV2 backbone architecture variant in the model config
change_num_classes: change the number of classification classes in the LinearClsHead config
adjust_loss_weight: adjust the CrossEntropyLoss weight in the classification head configuration
update_topk: update the top-k evaluation metrics (top-1, top-5) in the head config
